svg.title: Intermediate models: the building blocks
svg.desc: Diagram of the five intermediate dbt views: int_attempts, int_payments, int_approved_payments, int_fraud_cost_rates and int_shop_margins, with keys, joined and worked-out columns.
svg.text: Tries become payments and sales, each sale gets its fees and fraud cost, and fraud rates and shop margins are prepared for the fixes.
